culture.text: Makes industrial AI and ERP software (IFS Cloud) for companies that manufacture goods, maintain assets or run field service.
Headquartered in Linköping, Sweden, with about 9,206 employees; founded in 1983 by five university friends.
Staff often studied IT and computer science, many at Sri Lankan universities such as SLIIT and Moratuwa.
